rows.sentence: Member States have pledged themselves to achieve
rows.subject: Member States
rows.object: the promotion of universal respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms

rows.sentence: shall strive by teaching and education to promote respect for these rights and freedoms
rows.subject: every individual and every organ of society
rows.object: to promote respect for these rights and freedoms and by progressive measures, national and international, to secure their universal and effective recognition and observance

rows.sentence: They are endowed with reason and conscience
rows.subject: All human beings
rows.object: reason and conscience

rows.sentence: no distinction shall be made on the basis of the political, jurisdictional or international status
rows.subject: no distinction
rows.object: on the basis of the political, jurisdictional or international status of the country or territory to which a person belongs

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and the security of person.
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: life, liberty and the security of person

rows.sentence: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude
rows.subject: No one
rows.object: slavery or servitude

rows.sentence: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.
rows.subject: No one
rows.object: torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment

rows.sentence: All are equal before the law
rows.subject: All
rows.object: equal before the law

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to an effective remedy by the competent national tribunals
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: an effective remedy by the competent national tribunals for acts violating the fundamental rights granted him by the constitution or by law

rows.sentence: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile.
rows.subject: No one
rows.object: arbitrary arrest, detention or exile

rows.sentence: Everyone charged with a penal offence has the right to be presumed innocent
rows.subject: Everyone charged with a penal offence
rows.object: be presumed innocent until proved guilty according to law in a public trial at which he has had all the guarantees necessary for his defence

rows.sentence: which did not constitute a penal offence
rows.subject: any act or omission
rows.object: a penal offence

rows.sentence: Nor shall a heavier penalty be imposed
rows.subject: a heavier penalty
rows.object: than the one that was applicable at the time the penal offence was committed

rows.sentence: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary interference with his privacy
rows.subject: No one
rows.object: arbitrary interference with his privacy, family, home or correspondence, nor to attacks upon his honour and reputation

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to the protection of the law against such interference or attacks.
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: the protection of the law against such interference or attacks

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to seek and to enjoy in other countries asylum from persecution.
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: seek and to enjoy in other countries asylum from persecution

rows.sentence: No one shall be arbitrarily deprived of his nationality
rows.subject: No one
rows.object: his nationality

rows.sentence: Marriage shall be entered into only with the free and full consent of the intending spouses.
rows.subject: Marriage
rows.object: only with the free and full consent of the intending spouses

rows.sentence: The family is the natural and fundamental group unit of society
rows.subject: The family
rows.object: the natural and fundamental group unit of society

rows.sentence: is entitled to protection by society and the State
rows.subject: The family
rows.object: protection by society and the State

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to freedom of thought, conscience and religion
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: freedom of thought, conscience and religion

rows.sentence: this right includes freedom to hold opinions without interference
rows.subject: this right
rows.object: freedom to hold opinions without interference and to seek, receive and impart information and ideas through any media and regardless of frontiers

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to take part in the government of his country
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: take part in the government of his country, directly or through freely chosen representatives

rows.sentence: this will shall be expressed in periodic and genuine elections
rows.subject: this will
rows.object: periodic and genuine elections

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to work, to free choice of employment
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: work, to free choice of employment, to just and favourable conditions of work and to protection against unemployment

rows.sentence: Everyone who works has the right to just and favourable remuneration
rows.subject: Everyone who works
rows.object: just and favourable remuneration ensuring for himself and his family an existence worthy of human dignity, and supplemented, if necessary, by other means of social protection

rows.sentence: Everyone has the right to a standard of living adequate for the health and well‐being of himself and of his family
rows.subject: Everyone
rows.object: a standard of living adequate for the health and well‐being of himself and of his family, including food, clothing, housing and medical care and necessary social services, and the right to security in the event of unemployment, sickness, disability, widowhood, old age or other lack of livelihood in circumstances beyond his control

rows.sentence: All children, whether born in or out of wedlock, shall enjoy the same social protection.
rows.subject: All children
rows.object: the same social protection

rows.sentence: Education shall be free, at least in the elementary and fundamental stages.
rows.subject: Education
rows.object: free, at least in the elementary and fundamental stages

rows.sentence: Elementary education shall be compulsory.

rows.object: compulsory

rows.sentence: Technical and professional education shall be made generally available
rows.subject: Technical and professional education
rows.object: generally available

rows.sentence: higher education shall be equally accessible to all on the basis of merit
rows.subject: higher education
rows.object: equally accessible to all on the basis of merit

rows.sentence: Education shall be directed to the full development of the human personality
rows.subject: Education
rows.object: the full development of the human personality and to the strengthening of respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms

rows.sentence: in which alone the free and full development of his personality is possible
rows.subject: the free and full development of his personality

rows.sentence: solely for the purpose of securing due recognition and respect for the rights and freedoms of others

rows.object: due recognition and respect for the rights and freedoms of others

rows.sentence: Nothing in this Declaration may be interpreted as implying
rows.subject: Nothing in this Declaration
